sentences.zh: 臧宮眾多食少，轉輸不至，降者皆欲散畔郡邑，復更保聚，觀望成敗。

translations.literal: Zang Gong's host was many but food scant; relay transport did not arrive; the surrendered all wished to scatter and rebel against commanderies and counties, again holding together in defense and watching success or failure.
translations.idiomatic: Zang Gong's host was many but food scant; relay transport did not arrive; the surrendered all wished to scatter and rebel against commanderies and counties, again holding together in defense and watching success or failure.

sentences.zh: 宮欲引還，恐為所反；

translations.literal: Gong wished to draw back but feared being turned on by them;
translations.idiomatic: Zang Gong wished to draw back but feared being turned on by them;

sentences.zh: 會帝遣謁者將兵詣岑彭，有馬七百匹，宮矯制取以自益，晨夜進兵，多張旗幟，登山鼓噪，右步左騎，挾船而引，呼聲動山谷。

translations.literal: it happened the Emperor sent a Herald leading troops to Cen Peng with seven hundred horses; Gong forged an order and took them to enrich himself, advanced troops day and night, set out many banners and flags, climbed mountains beating drums and shouting, infantry on the right and cavalry on the left, drawing boats along—cries shook the valleys.
translations.idiomatic: it happened the Emperor sent a Herald leading troops to Cen Peng with seven hundred horses; Zang Gong forged an order and took them to enrich himself, advanced troops day and night, set out many banners and flags, climbed mountains beating drums and shouting, infantry on the right and cavalry on the left, drawing boats along—cries shook the valleys.

sentences.zh: 岑不意漢軍卒至，登山望之，大震恐；

translations.literal: Cen did not expect Han troops to arrive so suddenly; climbing the mountain to look, he was greatly shaken in terror;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Cen did not expect Han troops to arrive so suddenly; climbing the mountain to look, he was greatly shaken in terror;

sentences.zh: 宮因縱擊，大破之，斬首、溺死者萬餘人，水為之濁。

translations.literal: Gong thereupon loosed the attack and routed them greatly; beheaded and drowned were more than ten thousand men—the water was muddied thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Zang Gong thereupon loosed the attack and routed them completely; more than ten thousand were beheaded or drowned—the water was muddied thereby.

sentences.zh: 延岑奔成都，其眾悉降，盡獲其兵馬珍寶。

translations.literal: Yan Cen fled to Chengdu; his host all surrendered; they fully gained his troops, horses, and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Cen fled to Chengdu; his host all surrendered; they fully gained his troops, horses, and treasures.

sentences.zh: 自是乘勝追北，降者以十萬數。

translations.literal: From this they rode victory in pursuit north; those who surrendered numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: From this they rode victory in pursuit north; those who surrendered numbered in the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 軍至〔平〕陽鄉<ref>軍至〔平〕陽鄉據胡注補。

translations.literal: The army reached [Ping]yang village<ref>The army reached [Ping]yang village—supplemented per Hu's annotation.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached [Ping]yang village<ref>The army reached [Ping]yang village—supplemented per Hu's annotation.

sentences.zh: </ref>，王元舉眾降。

translations.literal: </ref>; Wang Yuan led his host to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: </ref>; Wang Yuan led his host to surrender.

sentences.zh: 帝與公孫述書，陳言禍福，示以丹青之信。

translations.literal: The Emperor wrote to Gongsun Shu, setting forth fortune and calamity, showing the good faith of cinnabar and green.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wrote to Gongsun Shu, setting forth fortune and calamity, showing the good faith of cinnabar and green.

sentences.zh: 述省書歎息，以示所親。

translations.literal: Shu read the letter and sighed, showing it to those close to him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Shu read the letter and sighed, showing it to those close to him.

sentences.zh: 太常常少、光祿勳張隆皆勸述降。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Ceremonies Chang Shao and Household Minister Zhang Long all urged Shu to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Ceremonies Chang Shao and Household Minister Zhang Long all urged Gongsun Shu to surrender.

sentences.zh: 述曰：「廢興，命也，豈有降天子哉！

translations.literal: Shu said: "Rise and fall are fate—how could there be a Son of Heaven who surrenders!
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Shu said, "Rise and fall are fate—how could there be a Son of Heaven who surrenders!"

sentences.zh: 」左右莫敢復言。

translations.literal: " Those at his side dared speak no more.
translations.idiomatic: Those at his side dared speak no more.

sentences.zh: 少、隆皆以憂死。

translations.literal: Shao and Long both died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Shao and Zhang Long both died of grief.

sentences.zh: 8帝還自長安。

translations.literal: 8 The Emperor returned from Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Emperor returned from Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 9冬，十月，公孫述使刺客詐為亡奴，降岑彭，夜，刺殺彭。

translations.literal: 9 Winter, tenth month, Gongsun Shu sent assassins posing as escaped slaves to surrender to Cen Peng; at night they stabbed and killed Peng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in winter, in the tenth month, Gongsun Shu sent assassins posing as escaped slaves to surrender to Cen Peng; at night they stabbed and killed him.

sentences.zh: 太中大夫監軍鄭興領其營，以俟吳漢至而授之。

translations.literal: Grand Master of the Palace supervising the army Zheng Xing took command of his camp to await Wu Han's arrival and hand it over.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of the Palace supervising the army Zheng Xing took command of his camp to await Wu Han's arrival and hand it over.

sentences.zh: 彭持軍整齊，秋毫無犯。

translations.literal: Peng held the army in good order—not the slightest violation.
translations.idiomatic: Peng held the army in good order—not the slightest violation.

sentences.zh: 邛穀王任貴聞彭威信，數千里遣使迎降；

translations.literal: Qionggu King Ren Gui heard of Peng's prestige and trustworthiness and from several thousand li sent envoys to welcome and surrender;
translations.idiomatic: Qionggu King Ren Gui heard of Cen Peng's prestige and from several thousand li sent envoys to welcome and surrender;

sentences.zh: 會彭已被害，帝盡以任貴所獻賜彭妻子。

translations.literal: but Peng had already been killed; the Emperor gave all that Ren Gui had presented to Peng's wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: But Cen Peng had already been killed; the Emperor gave all that Ren Gui had presented to Cen Peng's wife and children.

sentences.zh: 蜀人為立廟祠之。

translations.literal: The people of Shu built a temple and sacrificed to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shu built a temple and sacrificed to him.

sentences.zh: 10馬成等破河池，遂平武都。

translations.literal: 10. Ma Cheng and others defeated Hechi and thereby pacified Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: 10. Ma Cheng and others defeated Hechi and thereby pacified Wudu.

sentences.zh: 先零諸種羌數萬人，屯聚寇鈔，拒浩亹隘。

translations.literal: Several tens of thousands of Xianliang and various Qiang tribes gathered to plunder and held the Hao'ai Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of Xianliang and various Qiang tribes gathered to plunder and held the Hao'ai Pass.

sentences.zh: 成與馬援深入討擊，大破之，徙降羌置天水、隴西、扶風。

translations.literal: Cheng with Ma Yuan penetrated deep in pursuit and attack, routed them greatly, and relocated the submitted Qiang to Tianshui, Longxi, and Fufeng.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Cheng with Ma Yuan penetrated deep in pursuit, routed them completely, and relocated the submitted Qiang to Tianshui, Longxi, and Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 是時，朝臣以金城破羌之西，塗遠多寇，議欲棄之。

translations.literal: At this time the court ministers, because west of Jincheng's Poqiang the road was long and bandits many, debated abandoning it.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the court ministers, because west of Jincheng's Poqiang the road was long and bandits were many, debated abandoning the region.

sentences.zh: 馬援上言：「破羌以西，城多完牢，易可依固。

translations.literal: Ma Yuan memorialized: "West of Poqiang, cities are mostly intact and strong and easy to rely on and hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Yuan memorialized, "West of Poqiang, cities are mostly intact and strong and easy to hold."

sentences.zh: 其田土肥壤，灌溉流通。

translations.literal: Its fields and soil are fertile; irrigation flows through.
translations.idiomatic: Its fields and soil are fertile, and irrigation flows through.

sentences.zh: 如令羌在湟中，則為害不休，不可棄也。

translations.literal: If the Qiang are allowed to remain in Huangzhong, harm will not cease—it cannot be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: If the Qiang are allowed to remain in Huangzhong, harm will never cease—it cannot be abandoned."

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 民歸者三千餘口，援為置長吏，繕城郭，起塢候，開溝洫，勸以耕牧，郡中樂業。

translations.literal: People who returned numbered more than three thousand mouths; Yuan established chief officials, repaired walls and towers, raised walled watch-posts, opened irrigation ditches, urged farming and herding, and within the commandery all were glad in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: More than three thousand people returned; Ma Yuan appointed chief officials, repaired walls and towers, raised walled watch-posts, opened irrigation ditches, urged farming and herding, and the commandery prospered in peace.

sentences.zh: 又招撫塞外氏、羌，皆來降附，援奏復其侯王君長，帝悉從之。

translations.literal: He also recruited and pacified the Di and Qiang beyond the passes; all came to submit and attach themselves; Yuan memorialized to restore their marquis-kings and chieftains, and the Emperor accepted all.
translations.idiomatic: He also recruited and pacified the Di and Qiang beyond the passes; all came to submit; Ma Yuan memorialized to restore their marquis-kings and chieftains, and the Emperor accepted all.

sentences.zh: 乃罷馬成軍。

translations.literal: He then dismissed Ma Cheng's army.
translations.idiomatic: He then dismissed Ma Cheng's army.

sentences.zh: 11十二月，吳漢自夷陵將三萬人溯江而上，伐公孫述。

translations.literal: 11. Twelfth month: Wu Han from Yiling led thirty thousand men up the Yangzi to attack Gongsun Shu.
translations.idiomatic: 11. In the twelfth month, Wu Han from Yiling led thirty thousand men up the Yangzi to attack Gongsun Shu.

sentences.zh: 12郭人及為并州牧，過京師，帝問以得失，人及曰：「選補眾職，當簡天下賢俊，不宜專用南陽人。

translations.literal: 12. Guo Renji became Governor of Bingzhou; passing through the capital, the Emperor asked him about gains and losses; Renji said: "In selecting and filling all posts one should choose the realm's worthy talent and not exclusively employ men of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: 12. Guo Renji became Governor of Bingzhou; passing through the capital, the Emperor asked him about gains and losses; Renji said, "In selecting and filling all posts one should choose the realm's worthy talent and not exclusively employ men of Nanyang."
